Name: CHARACTER_INIT_PARAM
Description:
Defines instances of c0000 (player) characters in the game, including starting classes.
Note that many fields are not used and remain from earlier games, particularly with respect to starting classes.
Starting classes begin at 3000 with consecutive IDs, and starting gifts begin at 2400 likewise.

Fields.Name: Crimson Flask Max Charges
Fields.Description: Maximum charges of the Flask of Crimson Tears (capped at 14); extra charges are removed. 255 keeps the current value. Retail: 3 on most rows, 10 on 336 rows (e.g. 7400).

Fields.Name: FP Flask Max Charges
Fields.Description: Maximum charges of FP flasks (goods with Supple Type 2), applied like Crimson Flask Max Charges. 255 keeps the current value. Retail has no such flask.

Fields.Name: Additional Talisman Slots
Fields.Description: Talisman slots added to the base count from PlayerCommonParam; the total is capped at 4. Retail: 1 on rows 53500, 60000-60009 and 60800; 2 on 44 rows from 60100.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: 4 on 262 rows (e.g. 52000), 6 on 53 rows (e.g. 8500), 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Starting Crimson Flask Charges
Fields.Description: Flask of Crimson Tears given at the start: above 0 a filled flask with this many charges, 0 an empty flask, -1 none. Retail: 3 on 599 rows (e.g. 50), -1 on most others.
